name: SECOND BASE
source:
Taking place after winter break of 202X, Jerry Dalmond and Parker King attend Cherimoya College and cross their paths at the beginning of the new term.

This visual novel is a story of an enigmatic and heart-pumping blooming gay romance, where a non-experienced gay dalmatian and a sexually confused kangaroo try to figure themselves out, as well as their self-confidence with relationships.

[From [url=https://dalmond-team.itch.io/second-base]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在202X寒假后，杰里·达尔蒙德和帕克·金就读于番荔枝学院，并在新学期开始时相遇。

这部视觉小说讲述了一段神秘而令人心潮澎湃的同性恋浪漫故事，一只没有经验的同性恋达尔马提亚狗和一只性别困惑的袋鼠试图弄清楚自己，以及他们对人际关系的自信。

[来自[url=https://dalmond-team.itch.io/second-base]itch.io[/url]]
